description: A singleton helper class for managing shared preferences in a Flutter app, providing methods to initialize, read, write, and clear preferences with specific keys.

classes.name: PreferenceHelper
classes.description: A singleton class providing static methods to interact with shared preferences, reminiscent of a Kotlin PreferenceHelper.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SharedPreferences instance, must be called before any other read/write operations.

methods.name: writeInt
methods.description: Writes an integer value to shared preferences.

methods.name: writeBool
methods.description: Writes a boolean value to shared preferences.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string value to shared preferences.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer from preferences, defaults to 0 if not set.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string from preferences, defaults to 'en' if not set.

methods.name: getBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean from preferences, defaults to true unless specified otherwise.

methods.name: getLoginBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean specifically for login status, defaults to false.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all preferences, useful for logout functionality.
